sn45.152:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, rukkho pācīnaninno pācīnapoṇo pācīnapabbhāro.
sn45.152:1.2: so mūle chinno katamena papātena papateyyāti
sn45.152:1.3: yena bhante, ninno yena poṇo yena pabbhāroti.
sn45.152:1.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro.
sn45.152:1.5: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro:
sn45.152:1.6: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti -pe- sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn45.152:1.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto, nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāroti.
